text: Excruciating means so painful or stressful that it is very hard to bear. Waiting 11 minutes for a referee decision felt almost unbearable to the fans.
To languish is to stay stuck in a weak spot for a long time. A team that languishes at the bottom of the table keeps losing and cannot climb up.
Inept means not skilled and often doing badly. China's national team has been inept for many years.
A hukou is a household registration, an official record of which place a family belongs to. In these leagues, players need ties to their city, such as a hukou there.
A sponsor is a business that pays to support a team or event. In return, fans see its name on shirts, signs and ads.
Grassroots means coming from ordinary people in a community, not from the top. These leagues grew out of local towns cheering for their own teams.
Astroturf is a fake grass carpet used on sports fields. The title plays on it: real grassroots football on a field that is partly planned from above.
A renaissance is a time when something grows strong again after being weak. Here, the hometowns are getting new life and pride.
Legendary means so famous that people tell stories about it. Guan Yu is a general remembered from 1,800 years ago.
A general is a top commander in an army. Guan Yu was a famous general from long ago.
Mounted means climbed onto. The man mounted his horse before charging around the stadium.
A steed is a horse, especially a fine one.
Erupted means burst out suddenly and loudly, like a volcano. The fans erupted in cheers.
Thunderous means very loud, like thunder.
Chants are words that a crowd shouts again and again together.
A capital is the city where a province or country has its government. Changsha is the capital of Hunan.
A province is a large region of a country, a bit like a state in the US. Hunan is one.
Jerseys are the shirts that players wear in a team's colors.
Sweeping across a place means spreading quickly through it. The leagues are spreading fast across China.
Perennially means happening again and again year after year. The national team has been inept for many years.
Uneven means not the same all the way through. The players' skills are uneven: some good plays, many mistakes.
Fluffed means messed up or missed badly. A fluffed shot is one the player should have scored.
A goal review is when officials check a replay to decide whether a goal counts.
Copycats are people who copy something that worked for others. Other provinces copied Jiangsu's leagues.
A catalyst is something that makes a change happen faster. Officials hope the leagues will speed up the local economy.
Striking means very noticeable, so that it stands out.
Sluggish means slow and not very active. A sluggish economy grows slowly.
Devotion is strong loyalty and love for something, like a team.
Irrationality means acting from feeling instead of from careful thinking. Fans of any sport can be a little irrational.
Morale is how confident and happy a group of people feels. A morale booster lifts people's spirits.
Carnival-like means full of games, food, music and fun, like a fair.
Stalls are small stands where people sell things.
Relish is a tangy sauce or chopped-up mix eaten on the side of food.
Giveaways are free gifts handed out to people.
Superfans are the most dedicated fans of a team.
To belt out a song is to sing it very loudly and with power.
Opposing means on the other side. The opposing team is the one you play against.
A penumbra is a partial shadow around the edge of something. Here, the shadow of the property downturn is seen around the stadium.
A property downturn is when the value of buildings and homes falls and fewer get built or sold. Many flats stood empty.
Unoccupied means with nobody living or working in it.
Bemoaned means complained about with sadness.
Homogeneous means all the same. Tourist towns that all offer the same shops feel homogeneous.
Trinkets are small cheap souvenirs.
Inaugural means the very first of something. The first season was the inaugural season.
A Cinderella story is when an underdog suddenly wins big. Poorer Yongzhou became champion.
Clawed its way means got there through hard, determined effort, as if scratching upward.
A vein of feeling is a deep layer of it. Here, the matches tap into deep local pride.
Migration is moving from one place to live in another. Many people left hometowns to find work.
Hospitable means friendly and welcoming to guests.
Corrupt means dishonest, with people cheating or taking bribes for gain.
Match-fixing is secretly arranging the result of a game ahead of time, which is cheating.
Purity means being clean of bad things. Fans feel the amateur games are honest because there's no money in them.
To radiate is to spread outward from a center, like heat from a fire.
Rekindled means lit again. Rekindled enthusiasm is excitement that comes back.
To entice is to attract by offering something pleasant.
Amateur means doing something for fun, not as a paid job.
Resolutely means in a firm, determined way.
The pitch is the field where football is played.
The yuan is the money used in China.
A lottery picks winners by chance, like drawing names from a hat. Almost 90,000 people entered for the cheap seats.
Scalpers buy tickets and resell them for much more money.
Muscled in means pushed into a place or business by force.
Facial-recognition technology uses a camera to identify people by their faces.
Turnstiles are gates that spin and let one person through at a time.
A red card is shown by a referee to send a player off the field. The section title uses it as a warning.
Bureaucrats are government workers who handle rules and paperwork.
To vet something is to check it carefully before approving it. Here, officials check the entertainment.
Commercial deals are business agreements about making money, like ads and sponsors.
Standings, or the table, is the ranking of teams by their results.
A performance metric is a number used to measure how well someone is doing.
To lure is to attract someone, often with something tempting.
To wend its way is to move slowly along a winding path. Money is slowly finding its way in.
A hometown is the town where you grew up or feel you belong.
Seasoned means flavored with spices.
Fiery means burning hot, like fire. A fiery sauce is very spicy.
Minnows are tiny fish. Here they are dried and spicy snacks.
Small fry means small or unimportant ones, from tiny young fish. The article says small local businesses are doing well.
Big fish means large, powerful companies. The article warns they are circling, like sharks, ready to take over.
Circling means moving around something in a ring, like a shark does before it attacks.
